instruction: I invoked {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-FunctionName}} for the first time and got a 200 back with a jobId, which felt promising. Waited about 20 minutes and the log group {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-LogGroupName}} is still completely empty, no streams at all. Does that 200 mean the job actually started, or is something silently broken on this first invocation?
expected_answer:
The 200 does not mean what you want it to mean. The Lambda is a fire-and-forget wrapper: its handler is about ten lines that call batch.submit_job once and immediately return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': {'jobId': ...} }. It never polls, never describes the job, and never waits for a container to start. A 200 plus a jobId only confirms that the Batch control plane accepted the submission into the queue; it says nothing about whether anything ever actually ran.

The reason nothing is running is that the Batch job cannot start. The job definition {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-JobDefinitionArn}} references image {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-EcrRepositoryUri}} with no tag, so Batch resolves it to :latest, but the ECR repository {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-EcrRepositoryName}} is empty. No image has ever been pushed to it. Describing the most recent job on queue {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-JobQueueArn}} shows it transitioning SUBMITTED to RUNNABLE to STARTING to FAILED, with a statusReason indicating the container image could not be pulled from the repository (no manifest found).

A secondary observation worth knowing for later: even once an image is pushed and jobs run, the logs will not land in {{reference-architectures-Batch-openmp-us-east-1-LogGroupName}}. The job definition has no logConfiguration.options.awslogs-group override, so Batch's default awslogs driver writes to /aws/batch/job instead of the declared group. That is latent today because nothing runs, but the declared log group will keep reading as empty even after the ECR problem is fixed.
